Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL829152. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures, then to activities, then to assays. Filter by assay CHEMBL829152 and by exact activity measurements (standard_relation is '=' and standard_value is not null). Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
